outputs.night: 2026-10-12, run from local branch night/c07-integration-2 (origin/main + #48 + #52, unmerged) with the user's approval to start training

baseline.generation: bf16, deterministic batches of 32 (prompt length descending, then case id), left padding, dynamic KV cache, cap 1,024
baseline.note: The CPT parent never produces the PRM03 format and runs to the cap on most cases.

smoke.seconds_per_update_note: Measured under heavy CPU contention from another project. The uncontended pilot arms ran at about 12.5 s per update.
smoke.masking_gate: Passed on the live first batch: 16 micro-batches, 0 padding tokens supervised, EOS supervised in 16 rows.
smoke.resume: Deadline stop at update 10, then resume to update 20, completed. Bit-exact resume is covered by the C04 CPU test.

batched_eval_validation.decision: Keep the bound batch size of 32. The validator's choice of 48 saves little time and leaves less headroom for the desktop, and switching would invalidate the recorded baseline.

outputs.parity_references: Not produced on night 1 because C04 shipped no job for it. C03 prepares a job for a later night.
host_issues_fixed: systemd user services had a soft limit of 1,024 open files. The trainer peaks at about 1,350 and failed with 'CUDA driver error: unknown error'. Fixed with LimitNOFILE in the night-runner unit (#48).
The desktop holds about 2.2 GB of GPU memory, so the 2,048 MiB start limit never passed. The service now passes --max-gpu-used-mib 3072 (user decision, #48).
Batch-1 generation ran at about 11 tokens/s on WSL2, so DEV75 exceeded the 40-minute eval budget. Fixed with batched generation (#52).
Another project used about 30 GB of host RAM and all CPUs during the window. One resume failed with ENOMEM while loading optimizer state.

capacity.conclusion: C08's remaining arm, the R2 selection and the full arm A fit in one night.

notes: Night 1 also ran two C08 pilot arms to gate 268; see status/C08.json.
